# Confirm restoring an empty workspace clears saved entries

## What & Why
A restore can validly contain an empty answer and opportunity collection. Coverage should ensure stale entries already in the browser are removed rather than left visible after the restore.

## Done looks like
- Start with saved answers and opportunities in the browser
- Restore a valid workspace whose answer and opportunity collections are empty
- Verify both lists remain empty after reload
